content: python 'transitions' 0.9.3 is the popular FSM library (~6k stars). Good for in-memory state machines with callbacks/guards. For Dark Factory the authoritative state lives in Postgres and transitions are driven by orchestrator logic + persisted events; a hand-rolled enum state model with DB-enforced transitions (conditional UPDATE / SELECT FOR UPDATE) is preferred. transitions optional for modeling the role pipeline graph but not load-bearing.
